newsitem.title: USA: Civic stake held by California investor.
newsitem.headline: Civic stake held by California investor.

text.p: Donald Carr, a Napa, Calif., investor said he holds a 15.1 percent stake in Civic BanCorp or 684,267 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Carr said he bought 51,600 common shares between Nov 6 and Nov 15 at an average price of $9.31 per share.
The purchases were made through a broker/in private negotiated transaction with Canter-Fitzgerald, Carr said in the filing.
Carr said he holds the stake in the Oakland, Calif., company for investment purposes.
